description: This Java source file contains the implementation of the DefaultConnectionMonitorRegistry class, which manages connection monitoring via logging and counters in the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides methods to create, initialize, reset, and retrieve connection monitors based on various connection events and identifiers.

classes.name: DefaultConnectionMonitorRegistry
classes.description: Implementation of ConnectionMonitorRegistry that manages connection monitoring via logger and counter registries, providing methods to create and manage connection monitors based on various connection events and identifiers.

methods.name: fromConfig
methods.description: Creates a new instance of DefaultConnectionMonitorRegistry from a given MonitoringConfig, initializing logger and counter registries.

methods.description: Initializes monitoring (logging and counters) for a specific connection.

methods.description: Resets monitoring states for a specific connection.
